set.body: Objective: make spectral models, GLRM, every structured multiblock family, ModelSpec, solver evidence, fitted capabilities and multivar IR participate in one family-indexed lifecycle without collapsing mathematically distinct programs or results. Completion requires two genuinely different executable families, fold-safe tuning, runtime-derived evidence, referentially sound IR, JVM plus Scala.js law suites and updated public documentation.
set.title: EPIC: one lawful multivar lifecycle from model program to IR
